cases.refreshed: Every now and then, libraries need a little extra love from the communities they serve. You can volunteer away your library fines at a rate of $20 per hour while helping the library maintain a clean and welcoming environment. Volunteers will clean book covers with disinfecting wipes, dust shelves, and organize library materials. They will also use disinfecting wipes on computer mice and mouse pads, clear dust and debris with compressed air, and check books for damage such as torn pages or pen marks. Volunteers must commit to the full session. Anyone under 15 must volunteer with a parent or guardian. No experience or special skills are needed. Training and supplies will be provided. Space is limited.
